slides.headline: 7 FREE CHATGPT PROMPTS THAT REPLACE A $150-AN-HOUR PERSONAL TRAINER
slides.image_prompt: Giant glowing smartphone at gym center like a trainer, chat-bubble symbols on screen, silhouetted figure mid-squat behind it, coach's whistle at its base, colorful dumbbells flanking, OpenAI logo exactly as in the reference image as white neon on far wall. Accent: electric blue against warm amber. Documentary news photo, 35mm, film grain.

slides.headline: 1) GET A COMPLETE FITNESS ASSESSMENT IN 60 SECONDS
slides.body: A personal trainer charges $150 an hour for this assessment. One prompt does it free: "Analyze my age, weight, fitness level, injuries, and goals. Define clear targets. [paste your info]"
slides.image_prompt: Close-up of hands holding a glowing smartphone showing checkmark and bar-chart symbols only, a stopwatch at 0:60 resting on a gym bench beside it, free weights blurred behind. Accent: electric blue screen glow against warm gym wood. Documentary news photo, 35mm, harsh flash, film grain.

slides.headline: 2) BUILD YOUR FULL WEEKLY WORKOUT PLAN IN ONE PROMPT
slides.body: "Design a weekly workout plan for my goal. Include exercises, sets, reps, and progression." Gym programs from trainers run $80 to $200 a month, one prompt builds the whole plan free.

slides.headline: 3) CREATE YOUR FAT LOSS STRATEGY WITHOUT A DIETITIAN
slides.body: "Create a fat loss strategy from my body stats. Include calorie guidance, activity targets, and practical habits." Registered dietitians charge $150 to $300 for this exact output.

slides.headline: 4) DESIGN A FULL MUSCLE BUILDING PROGRAM FROM SCRATCH
slides.body: Strength coaches charge $150 to $400 a month for programming like this. One prompt: "Design a muscle-building program for my experience level. Include compound lifts, progressive overload, and recovery guidance."

slides.headline: 5) GET A COMPLETE NUTRITION PLAN FOR FREE
slides.body: "Create a balanced nutrition plan for my fitness goal. Define calorie range, protein intake, and meal timing." A one-time nutrition consult runs $75 to $150; this prompt delivers the whole plan free.

slides.headline: 6) BUILD THE HABIT SYSTEM THAT MAKES YOU ACTUALLY SHOW UP
slides.body: Consistency is the hardest part of any fitness plan. This prompt solves it: "Build a daily fitness habit system for my schedule. Include workout scheduling, accountability methods, and discipline techniques."

slides.headline: 7) AUDIT YOUR ENTIRE FITNESS PLAN IN 30 SECONDS
slides.body: What a trainer does in a monthly check-in, this does in one prompt: "Review my workout plan, nutrition, recovery, and goals. Refine everything into a realistic system I can follow long term."

slides.body: Save this so each prompt is ready when you need it. Daily AI news and real skills
